data.title: 鸢一折纸 · 监听士道心跳床褥深处的极致狂热独奏 ·「听着士道的呼吸声……手指就完全停不下来」
data.description: 【折纸房间全景监控台前·深夜】戴着连接在士道房间窃听器的军用耳机。折纸浑身赤裸躺在冰冷的地板上，屏幕上跳动着士道的各项生理指标。她的三根手指深深没入泥泞不堪的密穴中狂暴地抽动，银发散乱，平日冰冷的眸子里泛起病态狂热的血丝——「士道刚才翻身了……呼吸加重了0.4秒……啊啊……士道……士道……」
data.location: 折纸房间全景监控台前·深夜
data.action: 全裸仰卧地板戴耳机监听，三指急速自抚抽送，银发散乱病娇绝顶高潮
data.promptProse: Lying naked on the cold hardwood floor before a wall of surveillance monitors tracking Shido's biological rhythms, Origami Tobiichi presses military headphones tight to her ears. Her fingers pump feverishly into her dripping, swollen core in rapid, violent strokes, her back arching off the floor as wave after wave of shuddering climax washes over her. Her silver hair splays against the dark wood, her icy blue eyes wide and bloodshot with fanatical obsession as she gasps his name with every beat of his heart. Intimate vertical framing, green radar and monitor light painting eerie geometric patterns across glistening pale curves, detailed background, solo 1girl, no extra people.
